description: Replication Data for: Terrain-Informed Self-Supervised Learning: Enhancing Building Footprint Extraction from LiDAR Data with Limited Annotations is published by Vats, Anuja. It describes replication materials for a terrain-informed building-footprint extraction study using LiDAR. Coverage is national within NO. Spatial detail: 1 m DSM and DTM grids. The data period and sampling interval are not fully established. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. The metadata lists text/plain, application/zip; these files were not downloaded. Licence: CC-BY-4.0 source elevation data; ODbL for OpenStreetMap-derived labels. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. The training and test areas are sampled from Norway, not a complete national footprint inventory. The elevation and footprint labels retain different licences. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
